topic: OpenAI Decisions API: faster decisions for AI agents
caption:
Most AI agents don't need a paragraph to make every decision.

Classifying a message, routing a request, or choosing between a few actions is different from generating an explanation. Yet many agent workflows send both jobs through the same kind of model call.

OpenAI's Decisions API is now generally available with GPT-6 Luna. It returns typed answers to bounded questions rather than writing a full response. OpenAI reports up to 10× faster results than running Luna through the Responses API for comparable tasks.

Three details are worth noting:

• The endpoint accepts text, images, and structured JSON as evidence.
• A request can evaluate up to 400 questions.
• Your application still decides what to do with the answer. The API doesn't execute the action for you.

I think the useful design principle is straightforward: separate decisions from generation.

Use a decision endpoint when you need a probability, a choice, or a score. Use a generative response when you actually need a written explanation, structured output, or tool invocation.

Official details: https://openai.com/index/decisions-api/
